title: [Shortcut Guide] Core UI remains English when PowerToys language is German
summary: The localization gap is clearly reproducible, lists the affected strings, distinguishes core UI from manifest text, and provides a concrete implementation clue based on existing PowerToys language-loading patterns.

status.label: actionable design
status.detail: Start a focused localization design covering Shortcut Guide Settings and overlay resource loading, language initialization timing, and regression coverage for German and other supported languages.

judgment.rationale: The localization gap is clearly reproducible, lists the affected strings, distinguishes core UI from manifest text, and provides a concrete implementation clue based on existing PowerToys language-loading patterns.
evidence: The issue identifies German de-DE, PowerToys 0.101.2312.0, and Shortcut Guide as the affected utility.
PowerToys Settings is confirmed to switch to German while Shortcut Guide Settings and overlay chrome remain English.
The report lists affected strings including Search shortcuts, Close, Settings, Pin, and No results found.
The reporter points to ShortcutGuideXAML/App.xaml.cs and the missing ApplicationLanguages.PrimaryLanguageOverride/LanguageHelper.LoadLanguage pattern.
The issue has localization and translation labels but no visible assignee or linked work.
judgment.recommended_action: Start a focused localization design covering Shortcut Guide Settings and overlay resource loading, language initialization timing, and regression coverage for German and other supported languages.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Approve a focused design investigation for this recent issue.
